input: # A COMPOSITE header cell is coerced the way JavaScript coerces it.
# Array.prototype.toString is join(','): a nested array flattens, an
# empty array is the empty string, and a null element joins as empty.
# The refusal an object cell provokes reaches only a column name that is
# actually BUILT. With object:false the canonical never applies
# ToPropertyKey to a header cell at all, and a header-only document has no
# record to key, so all three runtimes return a value for these.
# header:false takes no name from any cell, so the object is a field VALUE.
# field.exact needs only the LENGTH of the header, so it fires, and fires
# first, on a row whose header holds a cell that can never be named.
# The strict-mode CONTRAST, and the one row in this file with strict ON:
# no field body is parsed, so the same cell is ordinary TEXT, names the
# column in every runtime, and nothing above is reachable.
